$note: Who vendors this package's built CSS, and where. A consumer that installs the package (MomentoMarks, a git dependency pinned by commit) is not listed: it resolves the package itself and cannot drift. A path that does not exist on this machine is skipped, not an error, so the build works on a CI runner with no siblings. Roots resolve against this repo's parent directory unless absolute; NFCCOOL_DESIGN_CONSUMER_ROOT overrides that parent. Sync UPDATES a vendored file that is already there and never creates one: a consumer adopts the package deliberately, with --adopt, not as a side effect of someone running a build.

business_card_service.why: Django, no npm at all: the built files are copied into its static folder and linked from the templates. dist/design-tokens.css is vendored on main since 2026-11-03: base_dashboard.html links it before dashboard.css, and the console's :root is aliases of these tokens, so a colour or radius the kit has is not typed in the console. dist/design.css is deliberately not vendored: the console still draws its components from its own dashboard.css, and the bundle would add 112 KB nothing reads. The store badges are vendored on main since 2026-10-13: the console's invite page shows them, and their PNGs since 2026-11-03: its mails do. Its mail shells extend dist/email/django/layout.html since then too, vendored as templates/nfccool_email/.
